## The motivating example, as written

::: foo

```{lmd}
return meta.stuff:map(function(v) return {=: **`{lmd} v`** :=} end)
```

:::

## Shared state, setup cells, and inline cells

```{lmd}
greeting = "Hello"
count = #meta.stuff
```

`{lmd} greeting`, `{lmd} quarto.metadata.get("author.name")` of `{lmd} meta.author.affil.org`,
with `{lmd} tostring(count)` things and `{lmd} {=[ *emphasised* ]=}` inline markdown.
A missing key is `{lmd} quarto.metadata.get("missing.key") or "nothing"`, and `{lmd} nil` vanishes.

## Nothing

```{lmd}
-- no return: the cell vanishes
```

## Echo

```{lmd}
--| echo: true
return {=:
### `{lmd} greeting`, world

A paragraph with *emphasis*.
:=}
```
